result.description: Customer service and support ticketing platform with help center, messaging, voice, and AI agents.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 access tokens preferred (Bearer, scopes; global OAuth clients for multi-customer apps). API tokens via Basic auth (email/token:api_token) are deprecated. Password Basic auth only if enabled in Admin Center.
result.access_detail: No free plan. Free 14-day trial (Suite Professional features, no card) for dev; sponsored non-expiring dev account (up to 5 agents) only for Marketplace partners. Sandbox needs paid Growth+/Enterprise plan. Customers on paid plans get API access; extra API volume needs 10+ agents. Public OAuth apps use global OAuth clients (may need Zendesk approval for Marketplace listing).
result.api_notes: REST APIs by product: Ticketing (tickets, users, orgs, views, macros, triggers), Help Center, Messaging, Voice, Live Chat, Sales CRM, Custom Data/Sunshine, AI Agents, Apps. Hundreds of endpoints. Rate limits per plan (~700 rpm cited by third party).
result.blocker: No permanent free tier; trial is 14 days. API token auth deprecated, must use OAuth. Official MCP status unverified (a blog claims first-party MCP launched Apr 2026 for ChatGPT-style use; general server reportedly unshipped).

evidence.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
Basic authentication is used for API tokens.
You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
Unlike a trial account, a sponsored account does not expire after 14 days.
Most of our APIs are organized by product capabilities.
